title: Minor stamina mead

# Minor stamina mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadStaminaMinor | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Minor stamina x1 | Duration: 2s | Cooldown: 2m | Stamina Regen: +80 Stamina over 2s

# Introduction

Minor stamina mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Minor stamina.

## Recipe

Mead base: Minor stamina is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Raspberries
• 10 Yellow mushroom
Six Minor stamina meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it restores 80 stamina over 2 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another stamina mead.

## Other locations

Other than brewing, Minor stamina meads can be found:
• In treasure chests at Infested Mines.
• Destroyed Ancient pots may drop them.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
